title: Generalized upper principal part of real planar polynomial vector fields
summary: The goal of this paper is to generalize recent results about the topological classification of the dynamics of a real planar polynomial vector field near infinity. Given a polynomial vector field $X$, using Newton polyhedra one can define its generalized upper principal part $X_Γ^{U}$. By dropping some monomials of $X_Γ^{U}$, we define its minimal generalized upper principal part $X_{G}^{U}$.
